landing.heroBody: Mnemio is a free flashcard app with spaced repetition. Create flashcard decks, generate cards with AI, and study at the perfect moment — learn it once, remember it for good.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to study and remember more.
landing.feat1Body: Import or type the exact words and terms you need to learn.
landing.feat2Body: Mimi turns a topic or note into a ready-to-study flashcard deck.
landing.feat3Body: A proven SM-2 spaced-repetition core schedules every review for you.
landing.feat4Body: Picture prompts and fill-the-gap cards, coming soon.
landing.feat5Body: Gentle momentum without the all-or-nothing guilt.
landing.feat6Body: Your decks and progress belong to you — export anytime.
landing.step1Body: Create a deck and drop in the vocabulary you care about.
landing.step2Body: Mimi fills in meanings and examples so you don’t have to.
landing.step3Body: Review at the right moment and watch mastery climb.
landing.aiBody: Mimi drafts cards from your notes, points out what you keep forgetting, and cheers you on — without the guilt-trips.
landing.aiBubble1: You forgot “saudade” twice. Want to drill it now?
landing.finalCtaBody: Free to start. Bring your own words and let Mnemio do the scheduling.
landing.faq1A: Yes. Creating flashcard decks, studying with spaced repetition, and discovering public decks are all free to start — no credit card required.
landing.faq2A: Spaced repetition is a study method that schedules each flashcard review just before you’d forget it. Mnemio uses a proven SM-2 algorithm to time every review for long-term memory.
landing.faq3Q: Can I make flashcards with AI?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Give Mimi, the built-in AI, a topic or your notes and it drafts a ready-to-study flashcard deck with meanings and examples in seconds.
landing.faq4Q: Can I study other people’s flashcards?
landing.faq4A: Browse thousands of public flashcard decks and study sets in Discover, study them online, or copy any deck into your own library.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect the email address and password you provide when creating an account, along with usage data such as the decks you study and your session history. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s2Body: Your data is used solely to operate the service — to authenticate you, sync your study progress, and improve the app experience.
privacy.s3Body: You can delete your account at any time from the Profile page. Upon deletion, all associated data is permanently removed within 30 days.
privacy.s4Body: We use Mixpanel and Google Analytics to understand how the app is used and improve it. These set cookies and collect anonymous usage events (for example, decks created, study sessions completed, and pages viewed). We never send your email, name, or the content of your cards. You can opt out by enabling “Do Not Track” in your browser or by using an ad/tracker blocker.
privacy.s5Body: For privacy-related questions contact us at

terms.s1Body: By creating an account and using Mnemio, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.s2Body: Mnemio is provided for personal, non-commercial study purposes. You may not use the service to distribute harmful content or attempt to circumvent security measures.
terms.s3Body: You retain ownership of the flashcard content you create. By using Mnemio, you grant us a limited licence to store and display that content to you within the app.
terms.s4Body: We aim for high availability but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access. The service may change or be discontinued with reasonable notice.
